name: ritornello-web
//: The root declares vite because npm hoists @vitejs/plugin-vue and @tailwindcss/vite here, and both `import 'vite'` at run time: Node resolves that from the root node_modules upwards and never reaches a workspace's own copy. Keep the range in step with the eight workspace manifests — they must all name the same one, or the root and the workspaces load two different Vite instances. Removing it breaks `npm run build` on a clean checkout while still passing inside a worktree, where Node walks up into the main checkout's node_modules.
